observation.command:
cd /workspace
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "start objections -> %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:8080/process/start/objections-management
sleep 75
a=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://localhost:18006/docs 2>/dev/null); echo "objections=$a"
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "start codec -> %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:8080/process/start/temporal-codec
sleep 75
b=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://localhost:18014/docs 2>/dev/null); echo "codec=$b"
